title: More visibility and control over Claude Enterprise for security teams
summary: Claude Enterprise adds security and admin features aimed at security teams, including a Security center (beta) that compares settings to Anthropic's recommended config with an exportable report, which is not a compliance certification. Inference hooks are now GA, letting prompt and pre-tool-call hooks check against existing DLP and security policies, and centralized management (beta) at admin.claude.com spans orgs under a parent, with EDR sensor support in Cowork VM (detection mode). Together these give security teams one place to review config, enforce policies, sign out members, and block personal accounts in Claude Desktop.

title: Make long-running agents faster with message threads
summary: Message threads are in public beta in the Claude Platform Messages API for long-running agent sessions. Clients send the full conversation once, then only new messages plus the previous response ID via a thread parameter, and threads expire after 5 minutes idle. Claude Code has it on by default with about 35% lower median time to first token on 500k-1M token requests, token usage is unchanged, and it is available on Claude Platform, AWS, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Cloud.

title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
summary: Ready-to-use interactive artifacts such as trackers and dashboards are now available for legal teams, and they can be shared and adapted. The legal gallery includes a cite checker, jurisdiction survey matrix, matter board, playbook deviation board, regulatory horizon scan, and contract review tool, plus partner artifacts from Goodwin, Harvey, Foley & Lardner, and PwC and nine access-to-justice artifacts. Claude for Legal now has 60+ connectors and a Legal Ambassadors Program waitlist, and a lawyer still reviews Claude's first pass.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Claude for Financial Advisors is a suite of connectors and workflow skills for research, meeting prep, and documentation, with 20+ connector partners including Charles Schwab, BlackRock, Addepar, Orion, and Wealthbox. Plugin skills cover meeting prep, notes and follow-up, rebalance review, estate and tax briefs, prospect intake, and compliance checks, and it is available in Cowork for Enterprise (recommended for RIAs for audit logs) with others able to request a license. Advisors keep approval over client communications and regulated actions.

title: New agents and products for security, productivity, and creative work on Claude Marketplace
summary: Claude Marketplace now lists 25+ partner agents and products spanning security (Chainguard, Checkmarx, Tanium), dev infrastructure (Datadog, Netlify), creative (Runway, Webflow), and productivity (Asana, Glean, monday, Zoom). Eligible enterprises can apply part of their committed Anthropic spend to partner solutions, for both new purchases and expanding existing tools. This means one commitment covers both Claude and partner products.

title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company
summary: IDC's Quanta technology intelligence platform is now available in Claude through an MCP connector, with cited answers for competitor briefs, vendor shortlists, and budget versus IDC forecast comparisons. IDC has rolled out Claude company-wide across engineering, product, marketing, and sales. IDC reports rebuilding its internal data repository in 3 weeks instead of about 3 months and cutting code review from 5 days to about 30 minutes.
